user.title: Edilkamin Control
user.description: Pick the stove thermostat published by the ESP32 firmware (MQTT).

entities.title: Stove entities
entities.description: Entities found on the device of {climate}. Check them, then choose the options.

data.chrono: Stove chrono (turned off when the schedule is re-enabled)
data.observe: Observe mode (computes without driving the stove)

data_description.presence: Empty house: alarm armed away or vacation, person away, empty zone, switch off. Used by each schedule's “If away” setting.
data_description.mqtt_topic: Leave empty to send no schedule to the ESP32.
data_description.schedule_format: v1 for the akoonet-13 firmware (5 slots, no days or silent mode).
data_description.observe: To run the integration next to existing automations: commands are only written to the logbook.
data_description.ignition_log: Only when an automation already kept the stove ignition list (« dd/mm hh:mm ; … », newest first): it is imported into the card's Ignitions button, then followed. Leave empty otherwise: the integration keeps its own history from the stove ignition counter.
data_description.firmware_url: Empty = project install page on GitHub. Can point to an ota.json file served by Home Assistant (/local/…) or another server.
data_description.windows: An open window turns the stove off if it is on and keeps the schedule from turning it on. The schedule resumes once they are all closed.
data_description.holiday_calendar: Calendar of the Holiday integration (Settings → Devices & services → Add → Holiday). Schedules ticked “Public holidays” apply on those days instead of the weekday ones. Optional.
data_description.window_open_delay: How long a window must stay open before the stove is turned off (0 = right away). Shorter airing does nothing.
data_description.window_close_delay: Time after the last window is closed before the schedule resumes (0 = right away).
data_description.stop_log: Stop list kept by the same automation, in the same order (« - » = ignition running, « ? » = missed stop): it fills in the stop times of the history. Leave empty otherwise.

end.name: End
end.description: End time (same as start: all day).

power.name: Power
power.description: Auto or Man. P1 to P5.

remove_profile.name: Remove a schedule
remove_profile.description: Removes a schedule and its entities.

set_profile_days.name: Schedule days
set_profile_days.description: Sets the days of the week of a schedule.

move_profile.name: Move a schedule
move_profile.description: Changes the position of a schedule (the first wins when they overlap).

publish_schedule.description: Publishes the fallback schedule to the ESP32 now.
